# Verma Caterers & Events

> Wedding & event caterers in Dwarka, serving Delhi NCR. Veg and non-veg menus, with pure-veg, Jain and satvik options on request.

Verma Caterers & Events (founded by Sandeep Verma) provides full-service event catering, floral decoration, sound/DJ/lighting, and end-to-end event management across Dwarka, West Delhi, South Delhi, Gurugram, Noida & Greater Noida.

## Key Facts
- **Business Name:** Verma Caterers & Events
- **Location:** Dwarka Sector 5, Madhu Vihar, New Delhi 110059
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 98104 83544 (https://wa.me/919810483544)
- **Email:** bookings@vermacaterersevents.com
- **Website:** https://vermacaterersevents.com
- **Google Reviews:** https://g.page/r/CYDtkWSK2D7TEBI/review
- **Service Areas:** Dwarka, West Delhi, South Delhi, Gurugram, Noida & Greater Noida (Delhi NCR)
- **Experience:** 15+ years culinary craft, 500+ events managed, 1,000+ delighted families
- **Menu Options:** Veg and non-veg menus, with pure-veg, Jain, and satvik options on request
- **Pricing Note:** Packages are customizable by guest count and menu selection (+ GST as applicable)

## Specialized Services
- [Floral Decoration & Mandap Design](https://vermacaterersevents.com/services/floral-decoration): Stage styling, jaimala setups, fresh floral arrangements, and theme decor
- [Sound, DJ & Ambient Lighting](https://vermacaterersevents.com/services/sound-dj-lighting): Concert-grade sound, DJ consoles, and wedding/corporate lighting
- [Event Add-Ons & Rentals](https://vermacaterersevents.com/services/add-ons): Event anchoring, stall booking, cooler rentals, and mattress rentals
